what: NetResult pool leak: in nsOnlineConnection::StateProxyDetection the vtable slot [9] (Exit) is a shared empty stub, ret 4, so the holder taken in Enter is never released. The patch points the slot at the existing Exit of the twin state StatePlatformNetworkStart.

search.note: Nothing is looked up by address. Both vtables are found through RTTI: type name .?AV<class>@nsOnlineConnection@@ -> TypeDescriptor -> Complete Object Locator -> vtable. The patch value is read from slot [9] of the donor, not from a constant.
preconditions: slot [9] of StateProxyDetection points at a function whose body is C2 04 00 (ret 4)
slot [9] of the donor has the shape: 83 C1 34 51 8B 0D <pool> E8 <rel32 Free> C2 04 00
Enter (slot [8]) of both states references the same global pool

applied: 2026-09-04, both builds. Verified with a disassembler on the game files: only slot [9] changed, 3 bytes differ from the backup.
